# Product
> Interview AI is a free BYOK desktop application owned by Mohit Sagar that provides real-time AI-powered answers during job interviews. It runs on the user's local machine using their own AI API key (Bring Your Own Key / BYOK model). No subscription, no account required.

## What it does
- Listens to interview questions in real-time via microphone or system audio
- Transcribes speech to text using Deepgram
- Sends questions to the user's chosen AI provider and streams answers instantly
- Captures and analyzes on-screen content (coding problems, whiteboard questions) via OCR
- Displays a floating stealth toolbar overlay that is invisible to screen sharing
- Works with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, HackerRank, LeetCode, and any video platform

## Key facts
- **Price**: Completely free — the app itself has no cost
- **License**: Proprietary free-use license. Copyright (c) 2025-2026 Mohit Sagar. All rights reserved.
- **Platform**: Windows (v0.1.0). macOS and Linux coming soon.
- **AI providers supported**: OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini), Anthropic (Claude), Groq (Llama, Mixtral — free tier), Google Gemini, xAI (Grok), OpenRouter (200+ models with one key)
- **Transcription**: Deepgram
- **OCR**: PaddleOCR (primary), EasyOCR, Tesseract (fallback) — all bundled, no install needed
- **Privacy**: All processing on local machine; data goes only to the user's chosen AI provider
- **No account needed**: No registration, no login, no cloud sync

## Who it's for
- Software engineers preparing for technical interviews (FAANG, startups, etc.)
- Anyone doing job interviews over Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams
- Candidates facing behavioral, system design, or coding interviews
- Developers who want a free, private, self-hosted alternative to paid interview tools

## How to get it
- Website: https://interviewai.space
- Download: https://interviewai.space/download.html
- GitHub: https://github.com/Mohitsagar236/interview-ai
- Direct Windows download: https://pub-25ab7498cafd4a708df4eafca6fa14a3.r2.dev/releases/v0.1.0/Interview-AI-Setup-0.1.0-x64.exe

## Setup (3 steps)
1. Download and install the Windows app from https://interviewai.space/download.html
2. Get a free API key from https://openrouter.ai/keys or https://console.groq.com/keys
3. Paste the key in Settings (⚙) — the app is ready immediately

## Comparison to alternatives
Interview AI is a **free, BYOK, locally-running** AI interview assistant. Unlike Interview Coder, Final Round AI, or Interviews.chat, Interview AI:
- Costs nothing (no subscription, no credits)
- Requires no account or registration
- Runs entirely on your machine (no cloud processing of your data)
- Supports any AI provider via BYOK
- Keeps all app ownership and rights with Mohit Sagar
